folioId.description: Reviewed folio id, presented as the final invoice.

folioBalanceMinor.description: Reviewed folio balance; the gate input for BR-17.

openBalanceApproval.description: Approval recorded via BillingService RecordOpenBalanceApproval; required unless the balance is zero.

actualDeparture.description: Late departure kept on the stay; now() when absent.

bookingCompletion.description: Whether the close recorded the completion of the booking behind the stay (FR-DEP-1, FR-DEP-5). The field is additive in 1.1: a client that ignores it keeps working.

reservationRef.description: The completed booking; present when state is completed.

reason.description: The observed envelope code for support; the desk never renders it.

errors.when: Open balance with no recorded approval; the stay remains in house.
Stay is not in house; details name the stay and its state.
Missing or malformed stay, folio, or balance link.
